title: Medieval & Illuminated
description: Gold-leaf devotion, manuscript marginalia, and the luminous glow of the Middle Ages.
source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Wikimedia Commons

items.title: The Cloisters Apocalypse
items.medium: Tempera, gold, silver, and ink on parchment; later leather binding
items.description_narrative: A radiant angel bearing a red-and-gold shield battles winged, multi-headed dragons in a starry blue sky, flanked by smaller angels holding round shields, dense gothic script and small painted beasts filling the page below.
items.tags: illuminated manuscript, apocalypse, dragons, angels, gothic, parchment
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: The Belles Heures of Jean de France, duc de Berry
items.medium: Tempera, gold, and ink on vellum
items.description_narrative: Within an arched, gold-bordered frame twined with ivy and berries, a robed figure in blue kneels before a haloed man supported by an attendant, a group of clergy watching from an alcove behind, dense script filling the page below. The Limbourg brothers illuminated this manuscript page in the 1400s; it belongs to the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
items.tags: illuminated manuscript, gold leaf, gothic, devotional, limbourg brothers, vellum
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Très Riches Heures du Duc de Berry: January
items.medium: Illuminated manuscript (tempera and gold on parchment)
items.description_narrative: Richly dressed courtiers gather around a long table laid with gold dishes as servants pour wine and carve meat, a woven tapestry depicting mounted knights in battle hanging on the wall behind them. The Limbourg brothers illuminated this page; it is dated from 1411 until 1416.
items.tags: illuminated manuscript, feast, courtiers, gothic, limbourg brothers, calendar page

items.title: Très Riches Heures du Duc de Berry: February
items.medium: Illuminated manuscript (tempera and gold on parchment)
items.description_narrative: Inside a wattle-fenced farmyard, three figures warm themselves by an open fire as snow covers the thatched roofs, sheepfold, and beehives outside, and a man leads a laden donkey past bare trees. Attributed to the Limbourg brothers, this illuminated manuscript page dates to between 1411 and 1416.
items.tags: medieval, manuscript illumination, february, winter scene, farm life, gothic, calendar page
